$comment: GENERATED from docs/harness/profiles by compose-harness-config.mjs. Policy lives in the adapter baseline (playwright.json); project facts live in the profile (playwright-boilerplate). Re-compose after editing either, then run npm run harness:sync.

rules.instead: waitForResponse() or a deterministic expect() assertion
rules.why: A fixed delay hides the real readiness condition and flakes in CI.
rules.message: Hard wait detected. Use a response wait or state-based assertion.

rules.never: a selector literal in a spec or helper
rules.why: A UI change should have one owner, not scattered copies.
rules.message: Hardcoded selector. Use a UI config constant.

rules.never: a route or endpoint literal when config exists
rules.why: Routes and API contracts need one maintained registry.
rules.message: Hardcoded route or endpoint. Use the config registry.

rules.never: page-object classes, action layers, or wrappers outside helpers/
rules.why: A second UI abstraction duplicates config and helper ownership.
rules.message: Page-object or action-layer dependency. Use the helper-first architecture.

rules.never: a password, secret, API key, or token assigned a literal string
rules.instead: environment variables loaded from a gitignored .env or CI secret
rules.why: A committed credential is a breach, not a style issue.
rules.message: Hardcoded credential. Read it from the environment instead.

rules.why: Authentication should be isolated and cached, not repeated in every test.
rules.message: Per-test login detected. Use storageState setup instead.

rules.never: a spec importing test directly from @playwright/test
rules.why: The fixture is the single injection point for helpers.

rules.never: POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE in a smoke spec
rules.instead: read-only assertions; put mutations in e2e coverage
rules.why: Smoke coverage must be safe against shared and production-like environments.
rules.message: Write request in smoke suite. Smoke tests must remain read-only.

rules.never: skip semantic locators without a reason
rules.why: Semantic locators are more stable and accessible.

rules.never: use first() or nth() where a filter can identify the element
rules.why: Index-based locators silently target the wrong element when the UI changes.
rules.message: Narrow the locator with a filter before using an index.

rules.never: a new config, helper, or spec without searching first
rules.instead: search literal selectors, routes, and endpoints by value
rules.why: Duplicate owners cause the same app change to need multiple fixes.
rules.message: Search the configs and helpers by value before creating a new asset.

rules.never: a test with no requirement tag, more than one, or an unknown id
rules.instead: exactly one known requirement id in the title and as a tag, plus Type, Priority, and tier tags
rules.why: The title survives every reporter and the tag supports filtering; together they make coverage computable.
rules.message: Test must carry exactly one known requirement id in its title and tags.

agents.name: project-bootstrapper
agents.description: Derive an approved project and application contract from verified sources before any test generation.
agents.when: Start a new project or module from no existing automation context

agents.name: playwright-test-automation
agents.description: Implement Playwright tests and helpers using the helper-first Config → Helpers → Tests architecture.
agents.when: Build a requirement-backed helper-first Playwright module

agents.name: playwright-bug-hunter
agents.description: Debug a failing Playwright test, trace root cause, and propose an exact compliant fix.
agents.when: Trace and repair a failing test

agents.name: pre-merge-qa-gate
agents.description: Evaluate supplied change and command evidence through the complete 6-phase pre-merge QA gate.
agents.when: Evaluate supplied diff and verification evidence and return the final QA verdict
agents.readOnlyRationale: Read/search only by design: the gate cannot edit files or execute shell commands, so the builder never grades its own output.

agents.name: playwright-cli
agents.description: Use Playwright CLI for token-efficient browser discovery, debugging, and codegen-first scaffolding.
agents.when: Use CLI-first browser discovery or codegen

agents.name: pr-creator
agents.description: Create a pull request with the repository's standard generated description.
agents.when: Opening a pull request with a generated description

agents.name: workflow-maintainer
agents.description: Simplify repository workflow scripts, agents, skills, and docs without duplicating ownership.
agents.when: Simplify workflow scripts, agents, skills, or docs
